claims: Carroll Taylor Wiseman was the wife of Reid Wiseman.
Reid Wiseman is the commander of Artemis II.
Carroll Taylor Wiseman was a pediatric nurse practitioner.
Carroll Taylor Wiseman passed away at age 46.
Carroll Taylor Wiseman had a five-year battle with cancer.
Artemis II mission is in April 2026.
During the Artemis II mission, the crew requested a lunar crater be named "Carroll".
Carroll Wiseman and Reid Wiseman were married from 2003 until 2020.
Carroll Wiseman and Reid Wiseman had two daughters, Ellie and Katherine.
Carroll Wiseman worked in the newborn intensive care unit (NICU) at Children's Hospital of the King's Daughters in Norfolk, Virginia.
During the Artemis II mission, fellow astronaut Jeremy Hansen told mission control: "We lost a loved one — her name was Carroll, the spouse of Reid, the mother of Katie and Ellie".
Reid Wiseman has often credited his wife for encouraging him to continue his career as an astronaut during her illness.
